market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Oil above $100 and rising yields create headwinds for equities. S&P 500 likely to test support as CPI data and Fed hawkishness dominate. Energy outperforms; tech and consumer discretionary underperform. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $110. AI capex cycle (Nvidia, data centers) and fintech innovation provide structural growth. Trade war resolution and Fed pivot would unlock equity upside. Consumer inflation remains key risk.
